causal_retelling: Researchers compared learned and predefined rules in simulations. Different cases changed the catch and breeding-biomass tradeoff, so the alternatives justify further investigation. But simulated gains may not meet management goals, so both rule types need the same catch-pattern and breeding-stock evaluation.

actors.Researchers: Affiliated with the Alaska Fisheries Science Center and built simulations informed by historical observations.
actors.Agent: Learning system practicing simulated harvest choices using feedback.
actors.Eastern Bering Sea pollock: Fish population examined in the simulations.
actors.Fishing businesses: Businesses needing sound management to plan seasons.

single_question_answered: What would make an AI fishing rule worth testing? Simulated alternatives justify further investigation against common catch-pattern and breeding-stock goals.
